Apsas. — This word usually refers to the body, meaning
‘front part.’^1 In one passage of the Rigveda,^2 however, the
adjective ‘with a long front part’ (dīrghāpsas) is applied to the
chariot (Ratha).
1) See Pischel, Vedische Studien, 1,
308-313; 2, 245, 246.
2) i. 122, 15. Cf. Roth, St. Peters-
burg Dictionary, s.v.
